translations.name: Hoboken Rent Leveling & Stabilization Office
translations.description: Hoboken's Rent Leveling & Stabilization Office helps anyone who has a Hoboken rental unit. Contact them by phone or email, or walk in. Open Monday to Friday 9am-4pm. Call 201-420-2000 ext. 1721.
translations.website_description: Learn about housing and utility help.
